01 · Profile

Formulation R&D is the direction.

My portfolio is built around the work I want to do next: formulation development, drug-delivery research, pharmaceutical technology and IPR.

I am pursuing an M.Pharm in Pharmaceutics at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, with a career direction in formulation R&D and pharmaceutical technology.

My interests include formulation development, vesicular drug delivery, nanocarriers, QbD, design of experiments, drug-release evaluation and computational approaches that support early-stage research.

My current M.Pharm research is an EDTA-functional glycerohylurosome for wound-healing applications, with work focused on formulation optimisation and in-vitro drug-release evaluation.

Development and evaluation of an EDTA-functional glycerohylurosome formulation for wound-healing applications, including optimisation and in-vitro drug-release evaluation.

Vesicular drug delivery

Computational screening · Alzheimer's research

Integrated Computational Screening of Marine-Derived Bioactive Compounds Identifies Fucoxanthinol as a Potential BACE1-Binding Candidate for Alzheimer's Disease

Integrated marine natural-product screening using molecular docking, ADME/toxicity profiling and molecular-dynamics workflows to investigate Fucoxanthinol as a potential BACE1-binding candidate.
